chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah and Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who died, and some of his heirs acknowledged a debt to a man, he عليه السلام said: “That is binding upon him in his share.”

key_terms.بِدَيْنٍ: with a debt; meaning a financial liability owed by the deceased
key_terms.حِصَّتِهِ: his allotted share of the inheritance

ai.seo_question: If one heir admits that the deceased owed a debt, does that bind all the heirs or only that heir’s share?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about an heir who acknowledges a debt owed by the deceased. The acknowledgment is binding only upon the share of the heir who made that acknowledgment, not automatically upon the shares of the other heirs.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5545 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Husayn ibn Uthman from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who died, and some of his heirs acknowledged a debt owed by the deceased to another man.
Imam (as) said: "That acknowledgment is binding upon the share of the one who made the acknowledgment."
